_meta.note: Integrity fix, not a scoring change. These 7 records carried an evidence_* confidence label while their own profile.confidence_note declared them placeholders with 'all scores null pending evidence'. scorecard-grind.md names this exact signature as the bug to flag: 'a candidate labeled evidence_* whose rubric is actually all-blank - no cited TRUE/FALSE answers and no footnotes (an evidence label with nothing behind it)' and records 0 such records as of 2026-07-17. Each of these has 0 non-null cells, 0 footnotes, 0 claims across all 13 categories (65 cells). Per the same doc, an unscored record stays confidence: null. No score, cell, source or status is altered by this dossier - only the confidence label and its note. Verified before writing: these are the subset of the 21 all-blank evidence_* records whose OWN note contradicts the label. Deliberately NOT touched: 5 AZ/PA records whose notes document a real completed rubric sweep with an honest no-data outcome (brian-del-vecchio, johnathan-buma, chris-donat, carter-weeks, naderah-griffin), and 9 VA/TX/FL local records from the 2026-06 local sweeps that carry no note at all - both groups need a human call, and are flagged in the overnight scorecard ledger.
